subject.title: fix(web-media): add timeoutMs option to WebMediaOptions for remote fetches

question: Should stalled Tlon media response headers time out after 120 seconds or 15 minutes?
rationale: Both durations have sibling precedents, but current Tlon code and docs do not define which user-visible failure cutoff is acceptable.

options.title: Use 120 seconds
options.body: Align with Telegram media header recovery and release genuinely stalled Tlon operations sooner.

options.title: Use 15 minutes
options.body: Align with the node-camera bounded-media ceiling and tolerate exceptionally slow header delivery.

recommendation.title: Use 120 seconds
recommendation.body: Align with Telegram media header recovery and release genuinely stalled Tlon operations sooner.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the shared timeout contract and is the strongest available routing owner for the cross-surface compatibility choice.
